blocks.description: Returns how much the view automatic capture is looking at would add, from 0 to 1. blocks.description: Measures the four outer corners of the projected time pattern in this camera's full-resolution image and builds a twtss/placement-observation from them. Needs the optical time decoder running on twtss.pattern.v2 and a calibration profile for the camera in Camera Source. Each frame's corners are found from the two outer edges of each lit corner cell and the frames are combined by median. The corners are named in the orientation the pattern is drawn, which is only proven while the camera is rolled less than 45 degrees and not seeing the pattern mirrored. A failed measurement clears the previous observation.

nested_field_policy.coverage: 固定Schemaの一般的な数値/string/enum/constはSchema rendererが処理。nested_field_templatesは候補/名前scope/再帰/variantなど専用UI例外を列挙し、各親引数へ展開。任意JSON/任意PROPSでは名前の意味を推測しない。
nested_field_policy.paths: pathはJSON Pointer風。*は配列項目。node_baseを起点にrecursive_viaを0回以上辿った各ノードへpathを適用する。variantは所有codecが判定し、inactive variantの値を追加/変換しない。property-nameはobjectのキーを編集する。JSON Schemaの$refとは別のUI適用規則。
nested_field_policy.collection: 固定shadowのliteralを所有の純粋codecで安全に解析して対象pathを収集する。非literal/不正sourceは評価せずスキップ。definitionは予定名であり登録済みを意味しない。既存下書きと保存済みliteral、実行registryを区別し、instance/target/session/reference/camera/capability contextを保持する。
